cases.name: array.geometry_vs_v2_recording
cases.against: tower x, y and base z, the room and 2T of docs/viewer-mockup/replay.json (the v2 recording); largest difference

cases.name: bundle.npy_round_trip
cases.against: 10^6 random f64 bit patterns and the awkward values written as .npy and read back; values whose bits differ

cases.name: bundle.round_trip
cases.against: a bundle of the staggered scene (five towers on their own clocks, a fifth of the shots lost, two bodies) written and read back; values of any array that differ in any bit from what the engine holds, and shapes that are not the stated ones

cases.name: cadence.window_loss_floor
cases.against: shots lost independently with probability p = 0.01 and 0.05 from 4000 shots every 5 s: the mean over 400 keyed seeds and 64 frequencies between the first two lines of |W|^2 - |W0|^2 (W normalised by the kept count, W0 the Dirichlet kernel of the plan) against p/((1-p)N); the worse |measured/predicted - 1|

cases.name: cadence.window_cycle_jitter
cases.against: cycle jitter as a random walk, positive U(T0, T0+d) and symmetric U(T0-d, T0+d), d = 0.1 and 0.3 s, T0 = 5 s, 500 shots: the mean of |W|^2 over 2000 keyed seeds at the alias 1/Tbar, 1.5 line-widths above it and at 1.37 times it, against (1/N^2)[N + 2 Re sum (N-k) phi^k]; the worst |measured/predicted - 1| of the twelve (each is also held to 3 standard errors of its mean)

cases.name: cadence.window_uniform
cases.against: the spectral window |W| of 200 shots every 5 s by direct sum against the Dirichlet kernel |sin(N pi nu T0)/(N sin(pi nu T0))| at 257 frequencies from 0 to 0.8 Hz, the five lines among them; largest absolute difference of |W| (the peak is 1)

cases.name: cadence.window_grid_jitter
cases.against: jitter about a grid, shot times n T0 + U(-0.3, 0.3) s, T0 = 5 s, 500 shots: the mean of |W|^2 over 2000 keyed seeds at the first alias 1/T0 against |psi|^2 |D_N|^2 + (1 - |psi|^2)/N; |measured/predicted - 1| (also held to 3 standard errors of the mean, and the line's height at N and 10 N to 3%)

cases.name: cadence.window_gapped
cases.against: planned gaps, L of every P slots of 5 s taken, L/P = 0.4 as 4 of 10 and as 40 of 100, fifty whole periods: the window's height at k/(P T0), k = 1..4, by direct sum against |sin(pi k L/P)/(L sin(pi k/P))|; largest absolute difference of heights (the peak is 1)

cases.name: cadence.periodogram_on_uneven_shots
cases.against: the cadence-lab scene (each cycle up to 0.3 s late, 2% of shots lost): the engine's periodogram of tower 2, by non-uniform FFT, against the exact Lomb–Scargle of the same shots; largest difference as a fraction of the peak

cases.name: cadence.window_alternating
cases.against: cycles of 5.5 s and 6.0 s in turn: the window's height at k/T_s, k = 1..4, by direct sum at 2000 shots against |cos(pi k T_A/T_s)|, and against the same at 20 000 shots; the larger absolute difference of heights (the peak is 1)

cases.name: engine.cached_sum_equals_cold_run
cases.against: superposition after a drag of one body and back, summed from kept contributions, against a cold run of the same scene; values of any channel that differ, to the bit

cases.name: engine.replay
cases.against: a session replayed from its journal, and from its journal saved as JSON; replays whose state digest differs

cases.name: engine.replay_bundles
cases.against: a session (every kind of edit, a drag, staggered towers, a jittered and thinned cadence, undo and redo) that exports two bundles and a scene, against the same session replayed four ways: from its journal in memory, from its journal saved to disk and read back, with the workers settled after every command, and with them never waited for; files of any replay that differ in any byte

cases.name: engine.thread_count
cases.against: the signals of three scenes (staggered towers on a jittered, thinned cadence; a sphere through the towers, with its warnings; two bodies) read on 1, 2, 3 and 6 threads; values, estimates, warnings and flags that differ in any way from the one-thread read

cases.name: figure.png_regenerates
cases.against: the comb's periodogram and signal as PNG figures (paper-column at 300 pixels per inch, slide), painted by two engines on the local adapter, each with a device of its own: the .png, .csv and .json files that differ in any byte

cases.name: figure.regenerates
cases.against: six figures of the comb (periodogram, signal, one tower's lower channel over a span, cadence window, flight diagram; SVG and PDF; four presets) written by two engines from the same commands: each figure, its .csv and its .json; files that differ in any byte

cases.name: forward.precision_far

cases.name: forward.quadrature_order

cases.name: forward.quadrature_on_the_anchors
